newsitem.title: USA: AMBAC hires Boyle for financial services.
newsitem.headline: AMBAC hires Boyle for financial services.

text.p: AMBAC Inc said Wednesday it hired David Boyle as senior vice president and division executive for its Financial Services Division.

Boyle, previously a managing director of worldwide securities services at Citibank, a unit of Citicorp, will oversee investment contracts, interest rate swaps, and other services for various state and local government entities.
Phillip Lassiter, AMBAC's chairman and chief executive officer, said in a statement that Boyle's experience "will be invaluable in accelerating expansion of our Financial Services Division."
